cohort: 252 women who gave birth at Fasa health centers in 2015 (126 cesarean, 126 normal deliveries).
finding: The most important factors affecting mode of delivery were: First childbirth, fear of normal delivery, cesarean history, education, spouse's occupation, and wife's education.
mod_finding: First childbirth, fear of normal delivery, and history of cesarean section were among the most important factors affecting mode of delivery.
